about: Exceptions for scripts/check-migrations.mjs. Each entry needs a reason. A duplicate number is allowed only for the exact set of files listed.

0051.reason: Both files shipped in the first public export (bbf40a2) and have already run on every database. Renumbering one would leave a recorded name with no file, and the registry refuses to start on that (orphanMigrationRefusal in apps/registry/src/store/postgres.ts), so the pair is grandfathered.
